svg.title: LocationStatus arc diagram — InBand, OutBand, SpanBand
svg.desc: Three arc diagrams showing the three LocationStatus variants for closed regions in a pseudoknotted RNA structure. Each panel shows a sequence of nucleotide positions with colored arcs for base pairs and colored region indicators.
svg.text: Child region lies inside one of the parent's two band intervals
Child region lies in the gap between the parent's nested border pairs
Loop spans between two consecutive rungs of the same band (assigned by enumerate_band_spanning_loops)
pseudoknotted parent (0, 14) — same structure as panel 1
SpanBand loop: Stack between outer rung (0,8) and inner rung (1,7)
One SpanBand loop per consecutive rung pair in each band
